note: RFC 4271 Section 9.2: "All newly installed routes and all newly unfeasible routes for which there is no replacement route SHALL be advertised to its peers by means of an UPDATE message." Re-judged 2026-10-26 by an independent auditor after the tags moved from plugins/rib/rfc4271_rib_bestchange_test.go (745b0890f8) to reactor/rfc4271_rs_replacement_test.go. Both carriers drive the real bgp-rs, bgp-rib and bgp-adj-rib-in over live TCP sessions and judge the client's replayed TCP history behind a causal fence taken once the client owes nothing. Positive TestRFC4271RouteServerLastSourceWithdrawalIsSent: the only source withdraws P; the client no longer holds P, saw exactly one withdrawal of P and exactly one announcement (no re-announcement), so the no-replacement clause is asserted at the wire, not as an internal event. Negative TestRFC4271RouteServerOwnerWithdrawalSendsReplacement: the owner of the held best withdraws while another source's route is retained; the client ends on the retained route's exact attributes with zero withdrawals of P, which proves both the newly installed replacement is advertised and the bare withdrawal is confined to the no-replacement case; the earlier newly-installed steps (B's route, then A's better route reaching C) are also asserted. Discrimination records verified: revert of relay_recovery.go::queueRecoveryWithdrawal reddens the positive; mutant owesWithdrawal 'entry == nil' -> true (owner withdrawal sent bare) reddens the negative. The earlier weak finding (an internal BestChangeWithdraw event, no UPDATE, no newly-installed carrier) is answered by the new units. Scope read: owesWithdrawal/oweAnnouncement (session_ownership.go) and recoveryOwedFor (recovery_owed.go) do not branch on RSClient, so the RS-client fixture exercises the general non-ADD-PATH path; when the RIB recovery owner is not attached to the source, the bare withdrawal is sent with a warning naming the attach fix (ownerReceives), a misconfiguration path no tag covers. Independent companion-fixture rejudgment against RFC 4271 Section 9.2 and both complete tagged live-session carriers: the no-survivor case still requires the client to lose the prefix through exactly one withdrawal and no spurious announcement; the survivor case still requires the retained source's exact attributes and zero bare withdrawals, following demonstrated newly-installed announcements. Both judge bounded TCP history after settled decisions and a causal subsequent wire fence. The only affecting shared fixture repair supplies separately owned terminal interior host routes and asserts actual next-hop resolution before received BGP routes are judged. It neither creates the subject BGP prefixes nor changes their announcements, withdrawals, selection conditions, wire observations or assertions. Existing two-entry scope and enforced verdict remain; native producer-break renewal is separate from this source judgment. Independent acceptance of the actual negative retarget: read the complete native job-closure-rfc-renewal-27-8c3adeeb.log, the current complete tagged unit and Session.recoveryOwedFor producer, and the resulting native record. The named clean unit passed in 0.15s. The normal-return broken run passed the useful B-first then better-A baselines and reported only the post-A-withdrawal failures at rfc4271_rs_replacement_test.go:75 and :76: the recipient lost 203.0.113.0/24 instead of retaining B's exact attributes, and its withdrawal history was 1 rather than 0. There was no earlier baseline, setup, compiler or panic failure. Native recording accepted the existing negative cover with the new Session.recoveryOwedFor producer. This deliberately makes a registered, source-attached recovery owner appear unavailable and bypasses contested announcement election as well as owner-withdrawal election; it is an explicit broader same-claim semantic retarget, not a mechanical renewal of the historical narrower owesWithdrawal mutation. The actual assertions isolate the later replacement obligation despite that broader producer cut. The test body, tag claim, full two-entry row breadth and enforced verdict remain unchanged. Add the accepted stable Session.recoveryOwedFor producer as a code fingerprint boundary; native audit-stamp computes its value. This observation does not prove unready adjOutSelected behavior and does not stand in for the row's separate positive record renewal.
